title: Have / Has
summary: Have with I, you, we, they. Has with he, she, it. Questions and negatives use do/does + base have: Does he have a bike?
rule: Have with I, you, we, they. Has with he, she, it. Questions and negatives use do/does + base have: Does he have a bike?
tutorHints: Drill has with he/she/it every lesson until automatic.
